[[File:Nicky Unova.png|thumb|250px|Nicky]] '''Nicky''' (Japanese: '''クック''' ''Kukku'') is a minor character appearing in {{B2W2}} and {{aniseries|BW}}. He is the drummer for [[Roxie]]'s band. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|BW}}==== Nicky appeared in ''[[BW083|Rocking the Virbank Gym! Part 1]]'' and ''[[BW084|Rocking the Virbank Gym! Part 2]]''. He is a drummer playing with [[Roxie]] and [[Billy Jo]] in the band "{{p|Koffing}} and the Toxics", which is quite well known in [[Unova]]. He also provides music during Roxie's Gym battles. During the battle Roxie had with {{Ash}}, he interacted with the audience several times and stirred them up so they could cheer for Roxie. He once went on tour with the band through [[Kanto]]. ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{poison color}}|bordercolor={{poison color light}} |ja=佐藤健輔 ''[[Kensuke Satō]]'' |en=[[Tom Wayland]] |cs=Marek Libert |fi=Antti L. J. Pääkkönen |es_la=Luis Fernando Orozco |es_eu=José Escobosa |no=Tommy Karlsen |pl=Mateusz Narloch}} ==In the games== Nicky appears at the [[Virbank Gym]] in {{2v2|Black|White|2}}. Here, he also plays in a band with Roxie, just like in {{aniseries|BW}}.
